catalog.scope: Private admission counts. Each collection loads separately. Related-record limits below apply to their named parent, not to your whole account. This is not storage, traffic, provider quota or billing evidence.

scopedLimits.label: Source retrieval attempts
scopedLimits.note: Pending, captured and failed attempts count. A repeated request consumes another attempt.

scopedLimits.label: Claim reviews
scopedLimits.note: Exact immutable replay returns the existing review at capacity.

scopedLimits.label: Validation plans
scopedLimits.note: An identical frozen plan returns the existing record at capacity.

scopedLimits.label: Validation observations
scopedLimits.note: Exact immutable replay returns the existing observation at capacity.

scopedLimits.label: Paired experiment trials
scopedLimits.note: Exact case replay returns the existing trial; a conflicting case remains rejected.

rows.label: Missions
rows.scope: All saved missions count, including complete and cancelled missions. Existing evidence is retained.

rows.label: Manual memory saves
rows.scope: Counts new manual saves under these limits. Older notes and automatically generated evidence are retained and excluded.

rows.label: Learning evidence reviews
rows.scope: Every retained review counts. Selected evidence snapshots are limited to 300,000 UTF-8 bytes.

rows.label: Comparison protocols
rows.scope: Open and closed protocols both count.

rows.label: Scientific protocols
rows.scope: Open and closed protocols both count.

rows.label: Generality protocols
rows.scope: Open and closed protocols both count.

rows.label: Integration packages
rows.scope: Every version counts, including retired versions.

rows.label: Active runtime receipts
rows.scope: Pending, complete and failed active receipts count. Retired media history is excluded.

rows.label: Product event sources
rows.scope: Enabled and disabled event sources count.

rows.label: Provider invoice comparisons
rows.scope: Every immutable comparison counts. Invoice authenticity remains separate.
